en.如后台服务不可用，请在管理员 PowerShell 中运行：\nRestart-:
If the service is unavailable, run in PowerShell as administrator:
Restart-Service calabi
en.如后台服务不可用，请在终端运行：\nsudo launchctl kicksta:
If the service is unavailable, run in Terminal:
sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.calabi.daemon
en.如后台服务不可用，请在终端运行：\nsudo calabi daemon res:
If the service is unavailable, run in a terminal:
sudo calabi daemon restart
en.后台组网与端点继续运行。文件接收和进行中的传输将停止。: Mesh and endpoints will keep running in the background. File reception and active transfers will stop.
en.组网、端点和文件传输将停止。: Mesh, endpoints, and file transfers will stop.
